3 13-08-2024 We have heard Mr. Ansul, the learned Advocate for the sole appellant, who has been convicted under Sections 376-DB, 324 and 354-B of the Indian Penal Code; and Sections 5(m)/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012 vide judgment dated 18.12.2023 passed by the learned Exclusive Special Court (POCSO Act)-cum-Additional Sessions Judge-VI, Begusarai in POCSO Case No. 39 of 2023, arising out of Sahebpur Kamal P.S. Case No. 68 of 2023.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By order dated 20.12.2023, he has been Patna High Court CR.

APP ( DB) No.147 of 2024(3) dt.13-08-2024 sentenced to undergo R.I. for three years, to pay a fine of Rs. 10,000/- and in default of payment of fine, to further suffer S.I. for three months under Section 324 of the IPC; R.I. for life, to pay a fine of Rs. 50,000/- and in default of payment of fine, to further suffer S.I. for six months under Sections 5(m)/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012

. 
2. Two persons were tried and both of them, including the appellant, have been convicted.
The prayer for suspension of sentence of the other co-convict has been rejected by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court.

sentences.text: 3. Ms. Akanksha Malviya, the learned Advocate has appeared suo moto on behalf of the informant and seeks to oppose the prayer for suspension of sentence of the appellant.

4. After some arguments, Mr. Ansul seeks permission to withdraw this application for suspension of sentence of the appellant, but with a request to fix an early date of hearing in view of the young age of the Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No.147 of 2024(3) dt.13-08-2024 appellant/applicant and the mandate of Section 374(4) of the Cr.P.C.
5. The prayer for suspension of sentence of the appellant/applicant is dismissed as withdrawn.

6. However, the Registry is directed to prepare the paper-book with urgent dispatch and get the case listed for final hearing in the third week of November, commencing from 11th of November, 2024,
within first ten cases.

(Ashutosh Kumar, J) (Jitendra Kumar, J) Sauravkrsinha/ Krishna- U T Bablu Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92381403/
